Class Effects.Builder

java.lang.Object
io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.api.Effects.Builder
Enclosing class:
Effects
public static final class Effects.Builder extends Object
Accumulates sends and writes. Not thread-safe, and intended for use within one step.
